skills.description: In the Last Spurt, briefly raises target speed to surge past lagging rivals.
Activates on a random corner to gain a brief speed boost from smooth arc-running form.
In the early final leg while running mid-pack, triggers a burst of acceleration to begin overtaking.
Puts everything on the line in the Last Spurt — a far greater speed surge than Homestretch Haste, lasting the final stretch.
Masters every corner with academic precision — activates on any corner, mid or late, granting sustained velocity through the arc.
Reads the field in the early final leg and explosively cuts through gaps — a much stronger acceleration surge than Betweener Stance.
When locked in a neck-and-neck duel on the final straight, raises speed and acceleration to fight for position.
An overwhelming pursuit in the final straight duel — explosively boosts both speed and acceleration, threatening to overwhelm the rival completely.
Sharpens focus at the starting gate for a powerful launch — bursts forward with high acceleration out of the blocks.
Fixates an intimidating glare upon all rivals ahead in the late leg — sapping their stamina and forcing them into psychological retreat.
